abstract: Over a 7-year period, seminal analysis has been performed on 208 patients with testicular tumours, after orchiectomy, but before any other treatment. Only 22% of 54 patients with seminomas, and 29% of 154 patients with teratomas or mixed tumours, had sperm counts exceeding 10 million per ml. Very low sperm counts were observed in some patients who had previously fathered children. Post-treatment sperm counts were done in 117 patients, 80 of whom had received multiple drug chemotherapy: 42 of these men had pre- and post-treatment sperm counts. Overall, 24% of men receiving chemotherapy recovered sperm counts greater than 10 million per ml up to 3 years after therapy. Surprisingly, such recovery was seen in 35% of 23 men with initially poor sperm counts, but in only 26% of 19 with good initial counts. Only 27% of 49 patients with Hodgkin's disease had initial sperm counts of more than 10 million per ml; after chemotherapy only 1 of 29 patients recovered to this level. Only one quarter of these young men had semen which was adequate for cryopreservation. Artificial insemination with semen preserved in liquid nitrogen has been performed in 15 couples: 2 normal babies have been produced and a third pregnancy is progressing normally.
abstract_ja: 1983年の7年間に、精巣腫瘍で精巣摘除術を受けたが他の治療は受けていない208例について精液分析を行った。セミノーマの54例中22%、奇形腫または混合型腫瘍の154例中29%で精子数が1mLあたり1000万超であった。精子数の極端に少ない患者の一部は、既に子をもうけていた。治療後に精液検査を受けた117例のうち80例は多剤化学療法を受けており、そのうち42例は治療前後の両方の精子数が得られた。化学療法を受けた男性の24%は、治療後3年以内に1mLあたり1000万超まで回復した。驚くべきことに、初期精子数が不良な23例のうち35%で回復が見られたのに対し、初期精子数が良好な19例では26%であった。ホジキン病の49例中27%のみが初期精子数1mLあたり1000万超であった。化学療法後に同水準まで回復したのは29例中わずか1例であった。これら若年男性のうち、凍結保存に適した精液を有していたのは約4分の1のみであった。液体窒素で保存した精液による人工授精が15組の夫婦で行われ、健康な新生児2名が生まれ、3例目の妊娠も順調に進行している。
